title: Assess and report on cooling water systems
what: Have a competent person assess each cooling water system's Legionella risk before it starts operating and then as the regulation requires, and notify the council within 7 days of each assessment.

sources.title: Public Health Regulation 2022 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: The first risk assessment must be completed before the cooling water system commences operating

sources.title: Public Health Regulation 2022 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: The occupier of the premises on which a cooling water system is installed must notify the local government authority for the area, in the approved form, no later than 7 days after a risk assessment required by this Division has been completed

assessment.summary: Have a competent person assess each cooling water system's Legionella risk before it starts operating and then every 1 to 5 years, and notify the council within 7 days of each assessment.

marks.reason: Periodic risk assessments, audits and notices for each system.
